Husted HELP committee hearing artificial intelligence remarks humanity
grade_reason: No new statements were found. The existing record holds only level D statements about child safety with chatbots and competition with China, with no acknowledgment of catastrophic risk.
notes: Ran the two searches marked NOT RUN plus one follow-up on the Senate HELP committee hearings (Husted sits on that committee). None were refused. (1) Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act: the search results name Sanders as the only Senate sponsor (with Rep. Casar in the House and House Democratic co-sponsors). No source shows Husted co-sponsoring it. I did not check the congress.gov co-sponsor list, and the Sanders release summary PDF could not be read as text. (2) The superintelligence, artificial general intelligence and loss-of-control search returned nothing mentioning Husted. (3) HELP hearing: Medill on the Hill (9 October 2025, https://medillonthehill.medill.northwestern.edu/?p=45501) covers the 8 October 2025 hearing on AI in health care. It says only that Husted 'directed the committee to a bill he recently introduced' (the CHAT Act), with no quote. That is a child-safety point at level D, so I left it out. The Citizen Portal article on experts telling the HELP committee that unchecked AI could threaten humanity (cpo.soar.com) still could not be opened because the domain does not resolve. Whether Husted spoke at that hearing remains unchecked, and the official HELP committee video or transcript would settle it.
